title: Verbose payload logging in extensions
summary: Joomla extensions log request bodies, query results, or debug details in production.
rationale: Noisy extension logging increases storage, I/O, and privacy risk.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Gate debug logging, redact payloads, sample noisy events, and apply retention policies.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
